verdict.rationale: WezTerm documents a `wezterm cli` subcommand that talks to a running GUI or multiplexer instance to spawn programs and manipulate tabs and panes. That is a first-party, documented programmatic control surface an agent can drive, though the evidence describes it only in one-line summaries. Probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, and the pack does not show the breadth of the CLI or of any scripting API. Missing for 10: detailed reference coverage of the CLI's commands and output formats, evidence of a broader documented API (e.g. a Lua scripting API or machine-readable spec), and independent or hands-on corroboration of programmatic use.
